CombatService: claimFirstKO first; a claimed KO only sends Fx KO { By, Name, Faction '', Lost 0, Sack false, RespawnIn, First = true } + KnockedOut. MonsterService: rec.Quiet / _strike / _onKilled / Practice, a personal monster's kill needs no RewardMinHits and tells _onKilled after MonsterKilled, a practice kill = info.Practice + the PayAs kind's XP / gold, SpawnPersonal(...) -> model, rec (Near: no home-zone fallback; Hold: no swing before; a quiet one's lifetime end floats away), RemovePersonal, GroundAt.
